commit.message:
SDCP sigma_e anchor v2 registration (no results yet) and L214R-R04 close-out

SDCP: DC polarization reading of the 10-16 raw data (read_dc.py, galvani 0.5.0, 8-point I-V fits) gives SBE 7.016 ohm / DBE 2.178 ohm, i.e. sigma_e 1.63 / 4.68 mS/cm at 10 mm diameter and 90 / 80 um thickness; registration v2 replaces the old 4.47 / 12.4 anchors, calibrates sigma_VGCF on SBE (S1 ladder 1.309 / 0.6545 / 0.3272, ln-ln interpolation), compares SBE and the old DBE bed at sigma*, re-compacts only the DBE bed with 1 um mean SDCP agglomerates (existing --sdcp-agg-d knob, command fixed after a read-only bed record), keeps sigma_SDCP 256.6, leaves the ionic sigma0 calibration pending, and lists the manuscript figures and tables to regenerate. New kgy chain (scripts/sdcp_anchor_v2_chain.py, fake-runner selftest 15/15) and read-only bed record tool (scripts/sdcp_bed_meta.py).

LHS: ledger L214R-R04 claimed_fixed at 155534744; evidence gains the R04 test logs, an unchanged Codex probe rerun on the final code (no verdict difference from the 10-18 run) and the no-impact check 36/36; the Codex short recheck request now covers R04 and asks whether whole-record rejection fits a P3 label mismatch.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
